set.approach: Park at the pullout on the westbound Trans-Canada Highway about halfway between the Mount Norquay turnoff and the Bow Valley Parkway turnoff. Cross the animal fence at the runoff channel and follow the channel briefly, then climb the ridge on the right under the power lines, using a faint trail through burned timber to the crest. Follow the ridge to a col, bear right onto the ridge beyond it, and where a slab blocks the way drop left past a cairn through a wooded stretch and scree gully. Follow the clifftop to an opening where the upper slab is straight ahead. Calamari Crack climbs the corner just right of Escargot Corner.

review.notes: Area page gives the long approach; route page places the start right of Escargot.

set.descent_text: From the top-out ledge walk up and left, then up and right onto the ridge system. Follow the ridge to a sharp drop, where a boulder wrapped in a black chain serves as the rappel anchor, and rappel to easier ground. Then scramble down the ridge to the approach trail.
